items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Isaiah began to get younger fellas like Albert ! He was playing first trumpet and Isaiah Morgan playing second.

ctx.x: The Young Morgan with Sam added on or was it the old original Morgan band?
The Young Morgan band was the roughest after Sam got out of the picture, he got sick and when Isaiah took it over and then they began to get rough.
Well who was in that original band?
